title: Sample: Women farmers' household survey
description: An original demonstration questionnaire for trying NAARI. It is not a validated instrument and is not derived from any published index.
consent_text: This is a demonstration survey. Taking part is voluntary. You can skip any question or stop at any time. Your answers are seen only by the team running this survey. Do you agree to take part?

questions.text: How many people live in your household?
Does your household grow crops or keep livestock?
Who mostly decides which crops to grow this season?
options: I decide jointly with someone else

questions.text: Who mostly decides how money from the farm is spent?
options: I decide jointly with someone else

questions.text: Which of these have you used in the last 12 months?
Are you a member of a farmer producer organisation or self-help group?
On a typical day, about how many hours do you spend on farm work?
Is there anything else you would like to tell us?
